messages:
lina: quick sync — planning rollout for 'route-mux v1.2' next week. primary asks: tenant-level soft-pause, shadow A/B for v1.2 vs v1-small, and a clear composite hard-stop rule.
omar: thumbs up. prefer tenant whitelist for first wave (10 enterprise tenants) + 2 internal QA tenants.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: started canary roll: route-mux-v1.2 -> us-west1, cohort=enterprise-whitelist-10, rollout_id=roll-2066543210. Monitoring hooks: latency,error,token_rate.
zoe: telemetry gating proposal: P99 latency increase > 22% OR error-rate +0.5% absolute over 15m => immediate PAUSE for affected tenants. Also add tokens-per-response +35% anomaly.
patrick: add a degraded-response fallback: if model latency spikes but responses still correct, switch to 'degraded-mode' that trims max tokens and enables cache-hinting to reduce cost.
infra-bot: alert-bot: composite alert created: mux-v1.2-composite (p99_delta_15m=22, err_abs_15m=0.5, tokens_resp_15m=35). Page when cohort_rps>0.8.
lina: soft-pause API: implemented POST /flags/{flag}/pause?tenant={id} — ops can pause single tenant immediately without pausing cohort. Will add to runbook.
omar: shadow A/B: mirror 100% of sampled requests (deterministic hashing) to v1-small for 72h; collect quality metrics, redact PII, retention 21d. Do NOT surface shadow results in user-facing metrics.
zoe: Playbook items before region expansion: 1) whitelist stable for 24h 2) shadow run >=48h with quality delta <2% 3) soft-pause tested by oncall 4) kill-switch exercised in dry-run.
lina: config snippet for the flag service: ```json
{"flag":"route_mux_v1_2","cohorts":[{"name":"enterprise_whitelist","tenants":["ent-42","ent-73","ent-88"]}],"regions":["us-west1","us-east1"],"fallback":{"mode":"route_swap","target":"v1-stable","degraded_mode":"true"},"soft_pause_endpoint":"/flags/{flag}/pause"}
```
patrick: Agree on burst protection: require both 5m and 15m window breaches before paging oncall.
lina: scheduling a 30m dry-run tomorrow to exercise pause/resume and degraded-mode. please ack when you've reviewed runbook.
omar: Acked.
zoe: Acked.
patrick: Acked.
